description: Adds "template_props" as a native JSON object for template_category="cartoon" scenes, replacing the hand-escaped JSON string previously required in template_data for that category. Structured-output providers can only enforce shape on real object/array/string-typed fields, not on the textual content of a string field - asking the model to hand-serialize a nested object into template_data as an escaped string had no structural backing at generation time, so a malformed escape produced a string that satisfied the schema (any string of the right length) but failed downstream JSON.parse. template_props is validated natively instead. The 7 motion-graphics template categories are unaffected and keep using template_data exactly as before. MINOR bump per RFC 0007: template_props is a new optional field, template_data's meaning and requiredness for the existing 7 categories are unchanged, and 1.0.0-1.3.0 artifacts remain valid (no prior artifact used template_category="cartoon" in production).

search_terms.description: Concrete media-search subjects. Required only for non-template scenes; deterministic template scenes do not fetch stock media.

visual_style.description: Legacy media-generation/search style hint. Required only for non-template scenes.

fallback_terms.description: Fallback media-search subjects. Required only for non-template scenes.

template_category.description: If set, this scene uses a deterministic template instead of stock/AI scene media. The first 7 are documented in engine/prompts/visual_planner and use template_data; "cartoon" is documented in engine/prompts/cartoon_visual_planner and uses template_props.

template_data.description: JSON-encoded props for the 7 motion-graphics templates (timeline, ranking, chart, counter, comparison, list, text). Not used for template_category="cartoon"; see template_props.

template_props.description: Structured render props for template_category="cartoon" scenes, as a native JSON object rather than an escaped string. Documented in engine/prompts/cartoon_visual_planner.

background.description: Either a named location/variant/tone, or a flat color for a punchline/reaction beat.

camera.description: Camera behavior: static (default), zoom (from/to), or pan (panFrom/panTo).
